      Job Summary

      ProMach is seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Data Analyst to help transform our complex data landscape into actionable business insights. You’ll work with data from multiple ERP, CRM, and operational systems, supporting key business decisions in finance, operations, and supply chain. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on data work, cross-functional collaboration, and building impactful reports and dashboards. Fluency in Italian and English required

      Why This Role Matters

      As a Data Analyst at ProMach, you’ll play a critical role in shaping business strategy by collecting, analyzing, and visualizing data from dozens of systems and databases. Your insights will help drive efficiency, identify opportunities, and support growth across the organization.

      Key Responsibilities

      • Collect, clean, and analyze data from ERP, CRM, and other business systems to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
      • Develop and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and reports for business users and leadership.
      • Write SQL queries and use analytics tools to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.
      • Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to understand business needs and translate them into data requirements.
      • Present findings and recommendations through clear visualizations and presentations.
      • Support data migration, integration, and quality initiatives to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
      • Document data processes, definitions, and methodologies for transparency and repeatability.
      • Stay current with best practices in data analysis, visualization, and reporting.

      Qualifications

      Required:

      • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or analytical area, or demonstrated equivalent experience in data analysis or a related field
      • 2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
      • Proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
      • Experience building dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
      • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and data kccuracy.
      • Ability to communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
      • Experience gathering requirements and working with cross-functional teams.
      • Deep Knowledge of data flows within ERP/CRM systems (e.g., SAP, Infor LN, Salesforce) in a manufacturing environment
      • Candidate must be fluent in both Italian and English.

      Preferred

      • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Delta Lake).
      • Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and metadata documentation.
      • Experience with Python or R for data analysis is a plus.
      • Exposure to Agile project environments and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Git).

      Cosa significa per te?

      Con noi non ci sono vincoli sulle idee innovative né limiti per la tua crescita professionale. Offriamo un ambiente aperto e comunicativo che valorizza l’iniziativa personale. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un’azienda in cui le persone si trovano a proprio agio e scelgono di costruire la propria carriera.

      Oltre alle opportunità di sviluppo, come dipendente ProMach riceverai molto più del tuo compenso. Il pacchetto retributivo include la tua retribuzione, programmi di assistenza medica, un generoso programma di ferie retribuite e la possibilità di aderire a un piano di risparmio pensionistico con contributo aziendale. E poiché sappiamo quanto sia importante sentirsi tutelati, i benefici sono attivi fin dal primo giorno di lavoro: nessun periodo di attesa.

      Pro Mach, Inc. è stata inserita sette volte nella lista Inc. 5000 delle aziende private a più rapida crescita negli Stati Uniti.

      Continuiamo a introdurre prodotti innovativi, entrare in nuovi mercati, espandere la nostra presenza globale e acquisire nuove competenze.

      Offriamo le ricompense, le opportunità e la forza di mercato di una grande organizzazione, unite alla cultura imprenditoriale di un’azienda piccola e dinamica. Potrai godere dei vantaggi di lavorare in un’azienda in crescita che compete a livello globale, con il tocco personale e l’atmosfera di una piccola azienda dove puoi fare la differenza ogni giorno.

      ProMach è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità. Tutte le candidature saranno valutate senza distinzione di origine, sesso, età, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, religione o qualsiasi altra caratteristica tutelata dalla legge.

      In conformità alla normativa italiana, ProMach si impegna a garantire le pari opportunità e a favorire l’inserimento e l’integrazione lavorativa delle persone con disabilità. Possono essere previsti adeguati accomodamenti per consentire la piena partecipazione al processo di selezione e lo svolgimento delle mansioni previste. I candidati che necessitano di un accomodamento sono invitati a contattarci.

      AI Data Analyst

      We are now looking for a

      AI Data Analyst

      to join our team working for a better future.

      The position is permanent and the preferred location is in Trieste (IT), but also Helsinki, Turku and Vaasa (FI) are possible locations.

      What You Will Be Doing

      Wärtsilä Global Logistics Services (WGLS) is responsible for managing the end-to-end flow of Wärtsilä spare parts. Data plays a central role in how we run and improve our operations, and expectations from the business are shifting: users increasingly ask for faster answers, more proactive insights and lighter, more interactive ways to work with data. At the same time, AI has matured enough to make things like natural-language querying, automated analyses and conversational data agents realistic in daily operations. We are now looking for an AI Data Analyst to help us take this next step.

      In this position, you will focus on turning WGLS data into more advanced analyses and AI-supported tools that directly help operations. You will work across the full data lifecycle — from understanding what the business needs, to preparing and modelling data, to delivering solutions in the form of analyses, reports or conversational agents.

      As AI Data Analyst, your work will focus on these responsibilities:

      • Develop advanced analyses on WGLS data
      • Build conversational agents on top of our data that operational users can use directly to get answers in natural language
      • Create solutions that allow users to query both structured data and logistics documents (such as compliance declarations, supplier documents, contracts, incoterms and carrier tariffs) in natural language
      • Collect requirements from stakeholders and deliver the right solutions, whether as an analysis, a report, a dashboard or a conversational tool
      • Extract, transform and prepare data from different source systems as needed
      • Develop and maintain reports and visualizations where they are the best fit for the use case
      • Contribute to continuous improvement of our reporting and data practices, and to the transition of our data foundations towards AI-ready ways of working
      • Support WGLS users in adopting AI-based analytics tools safely and effectively

      To be successful in this role, we expect you to have:

      • Good command in SQL and experience working with data from different source systems
      • Programming experience in Python for data work
      • Practical experience applying AI / Large Language Models to data-related use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, retrieval-augmented generation, automated analysis)
      • Hands-on experience creating reports and visualizations, mainly with Microsoft Power BI
      • Knowledge of Databricks or other data platforms
      • Understanding of supply chain or logistics processes, together with a genuine interest in improving them and creating value for the business
      • Proactive, analytical and solution-oriented mindset, with a can-do attitude
      • Good problem-solving skills and ability to learn efficiently
      • Good communication, collaboration and presentation skills
      • Eagerness to use data end-to-end to deliver solutions

      An ideal candidate will have a B.Sc. or M.Sc. in a relevant field of study (technical, computer science, data/AI, statistics, commercial etc.) or similar practical experience.

      The annual salary range for Italy for this role is 35.000 EUR – 55.000 EUR in accordance with the salary provisions in the National Collective Labor Agreement for workers in the metalworking and plant installation industry (CCNL Metalmeccanico). At Wärtsilä, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. This range reflects the expected compensation for the role, based on market data and our job architecture. The final salary offered will depend on factors such as the scope and responsibilities of the role, the required competencies, and your relevant education, skills, and experience. We also take internal equity into account to ensure fairness across our organisation.

      Why you and us?

      We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership and taking responsibility of our work. We support each other’s growth and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

      We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe in that by being your own true self you can accomplish so much more. We don’t always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

      We have an amazing team and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.

      Contact & next steps

      We hope to hear from you soon, by submitting your application through our careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

      For further questions related to this position please reach out to Andrea Callegher, Manager Analysis and Automation, through andrea.callegher@wartsila.com (only for questions from direct job applicants, applications through email will not be recorded or responded to).

      The Role

       Ciao Games is looking for a data-savvy analyst/engineer hybrid to take ownership of the full data lifecycle across our published casual and hybrid-casual mobile titles. You will build the data infrastructure from the ground up, create insightful dashboards and reports, support game teams with actionable insights and help us scale our data-driven publishing operations.


      Key Responsibilities

      Data Engineering & Infrastructure

      • Design, implement, and maintain the data pipelines for mobile games (event ingestion, transformation, storage).
      • Set up integrations and dashboard with tools like GameAnalytics, Firebase, Singular, Looker Studio, BigQuery, etc.
      • Monitor data accuracy, schema consistency, and resolve data quality issues.
      • Build and own the data platform maintenance, alerting, versioning, and documentation.

      Analytics & Insights

      • Build and maintain real-time dashboards for KPIs (retention, LTV, ARPDAU, churn, conversion, etc.).
      • Perform deep-dive analyses to identify bottlenecks in progression, monetization, engagement, and player behavior.
      • Generate weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable PM/Studio/UA insights.
      • Run ad-hoc investigations based on stakeholder requests (e.g., post-release performance drop, A/B test results).


      Game Support

      • Collaborate closely with PMs, UA team and studios to define tracking specs and event structures for new games.
      • Evaluate early prototypes and soft-launched titles from a data perspective to flag red signals or potential.
      • Partner with UA to track campaign effectiveness and match in-game behavior with offerwall marketing cohorts.


      Qualifications

      Required:

      • 2-4 years experience as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, or similar in the mobile gaming industry.
      • Strong skills in SQL, BigQuery, or other cloud data warehouses.
      • Experience with analytics tools like Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or custom dashboards (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude).
      • Deep understanding of mobile game KPIs (retention, ARPU, ARPDAU, LTV, funnel analysis, etc.).
      • Familiarity with event-based data tracking frameworks in mobile games.
      • Comfortable owning both engineering and analytics aspects of the data stack.

      Bonus:

      • Hands-on experience with game data analytics tools, Firebase, or Singular similar tools.
      • Python for scripting or lightweight ETL.
      • Familiarity with A/B testing analysis and segmentation logic.
      • Experience working with hybrid-casual or casual games in publishing or development context.


      What we offer?

      • Full-time, permanent contract, salary depending on actual experience and knowledge.
      • Becoming part of a growing business at 400% YoY pace (i.e: right place, right time)

      Vuoi un mini spoiler su CPM?

      Ci prendiamo cura dei maggiori brand mondiali da oltre 80 anni attraverso diverse attività, dal merchandising alle vendite, dalla consumer activation al supporto clienti fino alla formazione sul prodotto. Questa è CPM, una realtà internazionale forte e dinamica, come le persone che ne fanno parte. Per te, rappresenta la grande opportunità di entrare a far parte di una solida multinazionale dove formarti e sviluppare la tua carriera in un settore in crescita e in un ambiente giovane, innovativo e super stimolante. Un’esperienza che ti metterà a contatto con i brand e le aziende più importanti in Italia.

      Candidati e… magari ci vediamo a bordo!


      Posizione


      Ti offriamo di diventare il guru dei nostri dati.

      Per te abbiamo una posizione come Data Analyst in un settore, il Field Marketing, dove la tua competenza può davvero fare la differenza.

      Potrai mettere in luce le tue capacità di analisi e interpretazione del dato al servizio di tanti brand diversi. Annoiarsi? Impossibile. Lavorerai nella nostra sede di Milano in spazi di nuova generazione e potrai operare anche da casa e ovunque grazie alle nuove politiche di smart working. Perché in CPM Italy siamo convinti che i tuoi risultati passino anche attraverso la qualità della tua vita.


      Ok, ma cosa farai di preciso?

      Il tuo ruolo riguarda l’analisi e la presentazione dei dati riguardanti la vendita, il posizionamento e la valutazione di campagne promo e di comunicazione in store dei brand delle nostre aziende clienti.


      Come?

      • estraendo, elaborando e pulendo i dati provenienti da diverse fonti attraverso SQL e Power Query;
      • sviluppando, aggiornando e mantenendo dashboard e report interattivi in Power BI;
      • monitorando la qualità e la coerenza del dato, garantendone affidabilità e accuratezza;
      • analizzando le performance dei progetti e individuando trend, criticità e opportunità di miglioramento;
      • trasformando numeri e KPI in insight chiari e azionabili per il business;
      • collaborando quotidianamente con il Project Manager di riferimento per supportare la gestione e l'evoluzione dei progetti sul territorio;
      • contribuendo allo sviluppo e all'ottimizzazione degli strumenti di Business Intelligence del team.


      Requisiti


      Sei tu la persona giusta?

      Per entrare nel nostro team Data & Analytics cerchiamo una persona con 1-2 anni di esperienza in ruoli di Data Analyst, Business Analyst o affini, abituata a lavorare quotidianamente con dati, dashboard e strumenti di Business Intelligence.

      Essere curiosi, precisi e orientati al problem solving è un ottimo punto di partenza, ma i veri must sono la passione per l'analisi del dato e la voglia di generare valore attraverso numeri e informazioni.


      In più è fantastico se...

      • hai una buona conoscenza di SQL e sei autonomo nell'estrazione e interrogazione dei dati;
      • utilizzi Power Query per la trasformazione e preparazione dei dataset;
      • hai esperienza nella creazione e manutenzione di dashboard in Power BI;
      • ti piace trasformare dati complessi in informazioni chiare e facilmente leggibili;
      • Excel è uno degli strumenti che utilizzi quotidianamente;
      • sai interpretare KPI e performance per supportare decisioni e attività operative;
      • ti entusiasma lavorare in team e confrontarti con colleghi e stakeholder di progetto;
      • sei una persona flessibile, proattiva e orientata al miglioramento continuo.
